name: flex_bottleneck
description: FLEX-style knowledge-guided information bottleneck (Nat Commun 2025): a 768→128 bottleneck on TITAN slide features with an MSI head, a gradient-reversal site adversary (removes site signal), and cosine alignment to site-free MSI/MSS text concepts. Targets cross-site (OAUTHC) generalization. Patient-grouped CV; few-shot curve K∈{1,2,4,8,16,all}. Frozen features.
